body:
This is what happens in PackerPeerUDP:

## `_poll()` - recieving packet
OS -> recv_buffer (created at init, 65 KiB) -> ring buffer (stores only actual data, not empty space, created at init, 65 KiB)

## `PacketPeer::get_packet_buffer` calls `PacketPeerUDP::get_packet()`
ring buffer (created at init, 65 KiB) ->  packet_buffer (created at init, 65 KiB) -> buffer (created at runtime)
buffer is returned

## 

I don't see how we can reduce the amount of copying without allocating/deallocating at runtime, which is much slower. Maybe when calling `get_packet`? EDIT: Implementing it, it's faster.
